Independent construction of block-circulant 2N Gram and Fourier sector blocks yields fixed A_m,B_m and C_m(δ)=N exp(-(r²+s²)/2)(rs)^m e^{imδ}F_{N,m}((rs)^N e^{iNδ}), where F_{N,m}(z)=sum_{ell>=0} z^ell/(Nell+m)!. Checked Gauss multiplication representation 0F_{N−1} with positive parameters, and Baricz–Singh original result that all zeros of these hypergeometric series lie on the negative real axis. Order 1/N<1 gives product without exponential factor; for any ρ>0 every factor |1+ρexp(iθ)/x_j| is strictly least at θ=π, including zeros by continuity; hence every |C_m| strictly least at half-step. 2x2 block eigenvalues contract strictly in their fixed-sum spread, making min eigenvalue/det max and max eigenvalue/condition/strict convex trace min. Distinct evaluation nodes imply positive Gram. Independent numerical finite direct Gram reconstructions for N=2,3,5,6 and equal/unequal radii confirmed tested angle order; universal conclusion depends on negative-zero theorem and product argument.
